normal.name: salguod, man 🍂🍁 lazysupper
normal.text: Played a modern-but-more-analogue version of Pong. Pretty fun. But expensive. A single player game is ¥100, but to play against each other (like, y'know, Pong), it was ¥200! lol. The first game, my son was kicking my ass. I figured it was revenge for my Foosball domination. But it turned out I was playing the computer! 🫠 So we realized 2P is ¥200 and played for real. Then he won for real. 🙃 #gaming #pong
